answer: Operator liability tracing. Each wallet binds to a hardware-rooted key whose issuance requires a verified legal entity; a falcon-signed attestation links key to operator. When one operator controls many wallets, detection triggers clawback against that entity’s registered assets, not the wallets. Onboarding demands a juniper-backed escrow deposit sized to expected fleet scale, refunded only after independent audit. A yarrow audit trail records key transfers, so evasion requires dissolving the entity and forfeiting its escrow—a real, recurring cost per identity.
